# Copilot instructions

This repository's instructions for coding agents live in `AGENTS.md`: the root
one for the whole monorepo, and one per area (`backend/`, `app/`, `desktop/`,
`site/`). Read the root file first, then the one for the directory you are
editing.

Copilot's coding agent reads `AGENTS.md` itself. This file exists for the
Copilot features that only look here, and it stays a pointer: a copy of the
rules would drift from them, which is what the root `AGENTS.md` forbids.
